rows.grounds: epithet describing cakraṃ; masculine form used attributively
numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing cakraṃ
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining characteristics attributed to the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the subject of description.
It is characterized as royal in nature.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is defined as a royal, eight-petaled wheel possessing a central pericarp.
uncertainties: The masculine accusative form rājānam agrees unusually with the neuter cakraṃ, possibly reflecting appositional or formulaic usage.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, eight-petaled, and has a pericarp.
